assertions.description: The route and filtered subject populations are derived from repository or rendered subjects and fail closed when their required population is empty.
evidence: lib/brand-v2-runners.ts derives public routes from registry.routes.public and throws when the public-route population is empty.
tests/e2e/brand-v2-article-interactions.spec.ts floors the registry-derived article route filter with articleRoutes.length > 0.
tests/e2e/brand-v2-reflow-320-200.spec.ts floors the rendered visible-text filter with sizes.length > 0.

assertions.description: Predicate inputs come from the subject under test rather than literals authored beside the assertion.
evidence: tests/e2e/brand-v2-route-flows.spec.ts derives font resources from PerformanceResourceTiming, body population and residue from the rendered DOM, and overflow from document scroll/client widths.
scripts/brand-v2-baseline.ts collects current manifests from repository subjects before compareBaseline evaluates them against the immutable baseline.

assertions.description: Expected-red wrappers must not mask enforcing functional assertions.
evidence: At audited commit 49b6fd71dc98e0c02ea529ae71a228fef00ac321, tests/e2e/brand-v2-route-flows.spec.ts filtered reflow failures out of its enforcing assertion and only attached them.

At the audited commit, tests/e2e/brand-v2-reflow-320-200.spec.ts wrapped the all-route zero-overflow claim in test.fail without a normal exact-set assertion, so an added overflow route remained masked.

Fix-forward commit ca1729e5f6dcda01d2e23b50baa1e44587ae269d records failedRoutes in expected-red-v1.json, enforces exact route-set equality normally, and leaves only the deliberately unreachable zero-overflow claim under test.fail.

assertions.description: The audited change does not introduce machine-local state into a committed artifact.
evidence: The full seven-file diff adds source, tests, and deterministic DOM measurements; it does not add a filesystem-derived committed artifact.
The baseline collector continues to derive source subjects through tracked repository inputs rather than the temporary audit worktree's untracked node_modules or out symlinks.

assertions.description: The public-route executor uses the registry-derived route population instead of hardcoding the revision count.
evidence: tests/e2e/brand-v2-route-flows.spec.ts maps brandV2Registry.routes.public and passes it to buildPublicRouteExecutionPlan.
contract/brand-v2-registries.json currently yields 61 routes, split into 47 article and 14 destination routes; the executor contains no hardcoded 61 acceptance literal.

assertions.description: Determinism and collection are paired with an independent comparison against the immutable baseline.
evidence: scripts/brand-v2-baseline.ts collectBaselineCheckResult calls compareBaseline on collection.bundle even when value-state validation failed.
The real combined mutation made the baseline gate report empty-value-state-population and an independent accessible-names changed-member failure together.

assertions.description: Every required filtered collection in the route executors has a non-empty floor before its predicate can pass.
evidence: lib/brand-v2-route-profile.ts checks fontResources.length === 0 before the same-origin every predicate.
lib/brand-v2-route-profile.ts checks bodyElementCount === 0 before accepting a zero backdrop-residue result.
tests/e2e/brand-v2-article-interactions.spec.ts asserts the filtered article population is non-empty.
tests/e2e/brand-v2-reflow-320-200.spec.ts asserts the filtered visible-text population is non-empty; filtered failure arrays are allowed to be empty because emptiness is their passing state.

assertions.description: The v1 reference archive remains exact-set enforced at six anchors on both measured reference surfaces.
evidence: evidence/brand-v2/expected-red-v1.json contains six failedAnchors for VAL-B2-EVID-015 and the same six for VAL-B2-EVID-004.
tests/e2e/brand-v2-reference-rubric.spec.ts compares the actual failing anchor arrays with archivedExpectedRedAnchors using exact toEqual assertions.

assertions.description: An empty observed font-resource population fails instead of satisfying same-origin checks vacuously.
evidence: lib/brand-v2-route-profile.ts emits resource-font / empty-font-resource-population when fontResources is empty.
The browser mutation blocked font binaries, cleared resource timings, observed [], and the targeted test passed only after asserting the tagged empty-population failure.

assertions.description: Literal 320 CSS px overflow is measured with a positive-overflow failure predicate and archived drift cannot expand silently.
evidence: lib/brand-v2-route-profile.ts correctly emits a reflow failure for every finite reflowOverflowPx > 0.
The forced 640px DOM plant at a 320x800 viewport produced positive measured overflow and the expected reflow failure.

The audited all-route executor nevertheless removed reflow failures from its normal assertion; fix-forward ca1729e5f6dcda01d2e23b50baa1e44587ae269d adds exact equality against seven archived v1 overflow routes.

assertions.description: All nine route check classes execute for every registry-derived public route and exactly reconcile with member.checks.
evidence: lib/brand-v2-runners.ts declares exactly nine ROUTE_CHECKS: browser-render, computed-style, axe, keyboard, forced-colours, reflow, overflow, resource-font, and residue.
The real route-flow run passed across all 61 registry routes in 1.1 minutes.
Removing executedChecks.add('axe') in the isolated worktree failed on the first route with expected axe missing, then the file was restored byte-identically.

assertions.description: A value-state validation failure does not short-circuit collection or mask independent manifest drift.
evidence: scripts/brand-v2-baseline.ts builds every manifest before returning value-state failures and merges collection.failures with compareBaseline failures.

The real isolated-tree mutation replaced all rendered not-disclosed subjects and separately drifted nav:/; npm run baseline:brand-v2 -- --check reported both empty-value-state-population and accessible-names changed-member in one ok:false failures envelope.

assertions.description: The structural dot-grid mutation pins the pre-mutation unregistered-device count at zero.
evidence: tests/e2e/brand-v2-reference-rubric.spec.ts asserts before.gridAndDevices.unregisteredCount === 0 before adding the radial-gradient grid.
The focused browser test passed and then verified the post-mutation count increased and the unregistered-device predicate failed.

assertions.description: The known structural-device blind spots are stated explicitly for later milestones.
evidence: Mission library/brand-v2-instrument.md states that the heuristic detects repeated background grids and thin rails but does not inspect box-shadow, SVG contents, or canvas pixels.
The same guidance requires explicit data-brand-device-id registration for devices rendered through those mechanisms.

knownBoundaries: The structural heuristic does not detect box-shadow, SVG, or canvas devices.

Box-shadow, SVG, and canvas devices must carry explicit data-brand-device-id metadata because a zero structural-unregistered count does not prove those rendering mechanisms contain no unregistered decoration.
The audited commit's seven-route 320px overflow set is archived v1 drift, not a product pass; fix-forward enforcement prevents that set from silently expanding or shrinking.
